name: smwgraphics-actraiser-bloodpool-act
title: ActRaiser - Bloodpool (Act 1)
description:
The second action stage of Actraiser, a poisonous swamp.

Just like the original game, using parallax scrolling in this background is highly recommended.

UPDATE: Reripped from scratch. Much more accurate to the source material, at the cost of an extra palette row. It's now extremely optimized, having a lot of free space in BG2 now. Palette and map 16 are also better organized. Background loops properly now.
